items.title: RT by @COUPSURE: Today, Russia expressed its thanks for the lifting of sanctions on diesel exports by dropping five glide bombs on residential buildings in Zaporizhzhia. As of now, sadly, twelve people have been confirmed killed, including three children. My condolences to all their families and loved ones. Another fourteen people have been injured, and two of them are in critical condition – the doctors are fighting to save their lives. The status of twelve more people who may have been there is still being verified. All emergency services are at the scene, and search-and-rescue operations are underway. items.title: RT by @DefMon3: "The first word brigade and corps commanders use to describe the first few months of Drapatyi's tenure is 'freedom'. Unlike his predecessor, who would tell some brigade commanders how and where to fight – even specifying the coordinates where a position should be set up – Drapatyi has chosen a different approach. He has opted to decentralize command, moving away from the 'micromanagement' that has already become widely known to the public... Ukrainska Pravda sources say the move away from hands-on management of brigades and corps has brought another change: Drapatyi no longer spends several hours every day hearing reports from all commanders, as Syrskyi did. 'Syrskyi would hear reports from everyone every day and could give specific instructions on how to respond to developments, including where troops should advance… Drapatyi doesn't do that; that's the job of the troop grouping commanders. Drapatyi focuses on strategic and systemic issues. And when commanders do speak to the commander-in-chief, he isn't interested in a standard report on 'what happened', but in statistics, analysing problems and finding solutions – in other words, what conditions need to be created for a particular commander to accomplish their mission. And that's the right approach,' a senior military officer told Ukrainska Pravda." https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/10/05/8056518/

Unlike his predecessor, who would tell some brigade commanders how and where to fight – even specifying the coordinates where a position should be set up – Drapatyi has chosen a different approach. He has opted to decentralize command, moving away from the 'micromanagement' that has already become widely known to the public...
Ukrainska Pravda sources say the move away from hands-on management of brigades and corps has brought another change: Drapatyi no longer spends several hours every day hearing reports from all commanders, as Syrskyi did.
'Syrskyi would hear reports from everyone every day and could give specific instructions on how to respond to developments, including where troops should advance… Drapatyi doesn't do that; that's the job of the troop grouping commanders. Drapatyi focuses on strategic and systemic issues. And when commanders do speak to the commander-in-chief, he isn't interested in a standard report on 'what happened', but in statistics, analysing problems and finding solutions – in other words, what conditions need to be created for a particular commander to accomplish their mission. And that's the right approach,' a senior military officer told Ukrainska Pravda."

items.titleUk: RT від @DefMon3: «Перше слово, яке командири бригад і корпусів використовували для опису перших кількох місяців перебування Драпатого на посаді, — це «свобода». На відміну від свого попередника, який казав деяким командирам бригад, як і де воювати – навіть вказуючи координати, де слід розташувати позиції – Драпатий обрав інший підхід. Він вирішив децентралізувати командування, відійшовши від «мікроуправління», яке вже стало. Джерела "Української правди" кажуть, що відхід від безпосереднього управління бригадами і корпусами приніс ще одну зміну: Драпатий більше не витрачає щодня кілька годин на доповіді всіх командирів, як це робив Сирський, щодня слухає звіти від усіх і може давати конкретні вказівки, як реагувати на розвиток подій, в тому числі, куди наступати війська... Драпатий цього не робить, це робота угруповання військ Драпатий зосереджується на стратегічних і системних питаннях. І коли командувачі розмовляють з головнокомандувачем, його цікавить не стандартна доповідь про те, що сталося, а статистика, аналіз проблем і пошук рішень – тобто, які умови необхідно створити для того, щоб той чи інший командир виконав свою місію», – розповів «Українській правді» старший військовий». https://www.pravda.com.ua/ukr/news/2026/10/05/8056518/
